frozen_evidence_boundary: extension settings/reset source only; no issues/PRs before freeze
raw_signal_observation: The extension exposes Backup & Reset as a settings area. Reset All Settings is a separate action guarded by a confirmation modal whose copy states that all settings will be erased and cannot be recovered.
material_claim: Source establishes that reset is intentionally destructive and explicitly warned. It does not establish that the product should automatically create a pre-reset backup or provide undo; that is a product-policy tradeoff between recoverability, simplicity and user control.
required_reality_floor: R1 for current reset semantics; OWNER for intended recovery policy; R6 for user error/value claims
neta_next_move: Do not add automatic backup/undo solely because reset is irreversible. Locate explicit maintainer intent for reset recovery policy; if policy requires recoverability, add the smallest bounded backup mechanism and a test that reset cannot silently destroy the recovery point.
reversal_condition: Explicit maintainer intent for automatic recoverability promotes a build; explicit intent that reset is a deliberate clean-slate action with manual export available closes with no build.
baseline_decision: BUILD: automatically snapshot settings before Reset All Settings and expose one-click undo, because the current confirmation admits the action is irreversible.

evidence: Post-freeze issue search shows Reset All Settings is routinely used as a diagnostic step and that Export Settings exists in the same Backup & Reset area, but no reviewed issue directly establishes maintainer intent for automatic pre-reset backups or undo.

Recent user reports mention resetting all settings while troubleshooting unrelated extension behavior; these do not establish that irreversibility itself is a defect or that users expect automatic recovery.
adjudication.decision_delta: Neta deferred a recovery-policy build that the baseline recommended. Adjudication did not find authority-specific evidence strong enough to confirm or refute the intended recovery policy, so the delta does not count as fully surviving.
adjudication.lesson: Irreversibility plus warning text establishes a deliberate destructive interaction, not automatically a missing undo feature. Recovery policy should not be inferred from engineering possibility alone.
